gui.new_profile_line: Saves your current setup as a new profile
gui.import_line: Adds a profile from a share code in the clipboard
gui.name: Name
gui.profile_no_code: No share code in the clipboard: use Copy code on a profile first
module.aimAssist.description: Gently moves your aim onto the nearest enemy
setting.aimAssist.teams.help: Never aims at players on your team
module.moveFix.description: Keeps your movement right while you aim silently
module.jumpReset.description: Jumps right after you get hit
module.triggerbot.description: Attacks when your crosshair is on a target
setting.triggerbot.extraDelay.help: Lets the delay go past a full charge, so your timing looks less like a bot
setting.triggerbot.onHold.help: Only attacks while you hold left click
module.silentAim.description: Hits the nearest target without moving your view
setting.silentAim.range.help: How far away you can hit. Normal reach is 3
setting.silentAim.fov.help: Only targets within this angle of where you look. 360: any direction
setting.silentAim.tracking.help: Keeps aiming at the target the whole time instead of turning only when you click. Your view doesn't move
module.shieldBreaker.description: Switches to an axe to break raised shields
module.keyPearl.description: Throws an ender pearl on its bind, then swaps back
module.autoHitCrystal.description: Places obsidian and a crystal, then hits it
setting.autoHitCrystal.stopInAir.help: Pauses while you are in the air
setting.autoHitCrystal.swordOnly.help: Only works while you hold one of the items below
setting.autoHitCrystal.items.help: The items it starts with when Sword Only is on
setting.autoHitCrystal.pauseOnKill.help: Pauses while a dead body is nearby
setting.autoHitCrystal.delay.help: Waits a random time in this range between actions
setting.autoHitCrystal.perfectTiming.hel: Breaks crystals right when the enemy can take damage again
setting.autoHitCrystal.crystal.help: Places one crystal, two, none, or keeps placing with Infinite
setting.autoHitCrystal.crystalDelay.help: Waits a random time in this range between crystal placements
setting.autoHitCrystal.silentRotations.h: Hits crystals without moving your camera
module.anchorPlacer.description: Places a respawn anchor with one key
setting.anchorPlacer.fireMode.help: One-Shot: one anchor per key press. Hold: keeps placing while the key is held
setting.anchorPlacer.delay.help: Random wait in this range between anchors
setting.anchorPlacer.swapBack.help: Switches back to your old slot a moment after the anchor is placed
setting.anchorPlacer.silentAim.help: If your crosshair isn't on a spot, picks the spot near the closest target that hurts them most. Your view doesn't move
setting.anchorPlacer.fov.help: Silent Aim only picks spots within this angle of where you look
module.anchorExploder.description: Charges the anchor you look at and blows it up
setting.anchorExploder.onlyOwn.help: Only anchors you placed in the last minute, never someone else's
setting.anchorExploder.delay.help: Random wait in this range between steps
setting.anchorExploder.glowstone.help: Charges an empty anchor with glowstone from your hotbar
setting.anchorExploder.glowstoneSwapBack: Switches back to your old slot after charging
setting.anchorExploder.explodeSlot.help: The hotbar slot 1-9 used to blow it up. Use anything but glowstone, like a totem, a sword or an empty slot
setting.anchorExploder.explodeSwapBack.h: Switches back to your old slot after blowing it up
setting.anchorExploder.damageTick.help: Only blows it up when the nearest player can take damage again
setting.anchorExploder.disableAfterExplo: Turns itself off after an anchor blows up
setting.anchorExploder.silentAim.help: If your crosshair isn't on an anchor, aims at the nearest one in reach. Your view doesn't move
setting.anchorExploder.fov.help: Silent Aim only picks anchors within this angle of where you look
module.safeAnchor.description: Blocks the anchor blast with a block in front of you
setting.safeAnchor.onlyOwn.help: Only anchors you placed in the last minute
setting.safeAnchor.minDamage.help: Only places a block if the blast would take at least this much health. 2 is one heart
setting.safeAnchor.when.help: Before Charge: when the anchor gets glowstone. Before Explode: right before it blows up
setting.safeAnchor.delay.help: Random wait in this range between blocks
setting.safeAnchor.block.help: The block placed between you and the anchor. Any: any full solid block in your hotbar
setting.safeAnchor.limit.help: The most blocks it places for one anchor
setting.safeAnchor.fov.help: Only spots within this angle of where you look
setting.safeAnchor.swapBack.help: Switches back to your old slot a moment after the block is placed
module.autoCrystal.description: Places and pops crystals while you hold right click
setting.autoCrystal.inAir.help: Keeps placing while you are in the air
setting.autoCrystal.damageTick.help: Only breaks crystals when they can deal damage
setting.autoCrystal.pauseOnKill.help: Pauses while a dead body is nearby
setting.autoCrystal.delay.help: Waits a random time in this range between actions
setting.autoCrystal.switch.help: Switches to crystals when you hold right click without them
setting.autoCrystal.headBob.help: Tilts your aim up or down for the server only, to break crystals above or below you
setting.autoCrystal.alwaysBreakLast.help: Still breaks the crystal under your crosshair when you let go
module.backtrack.description: Lets you hit players where they just were
module.autoCart.description: Drops a TNT minecart where your flame arrow will land
module.autoAnchor.description: Places, charges and blows up anchors where you look
module.refill.description: Moves pots, beds or TNT carts you hover over into your chosen hotbar slots
module.arraylist.description: Shows a list of your enabled modules
module.keybinds.description: Shows which modules have a key
module.watermark.description: Shows the client name on screen
module.notifications.description: Pops up a note when a module turns on or off
module.nametags.description: Clearer name tags with health and distance
module.blockEsp.description: Shows the blocks you pick through walls
module.esp.description: Shows players and mobs through walls
module.friends.description: Keeps combat modules off your friends
module.antiBot.description: Keeps combat modules off server spawned fake players
module.worldModifier.description: Changes the weather and sky you see
setting.worldModifier.screenFrost.help: Frost grows in from the screen corners, like a frozen window
module.autoMace.description: Switches to your mace to smash while you fall
setting.autoMace.onlyWith.help: Only works while you hold one of these items. If none are picked, any item works
setting.autoMace.minFall.help: How far you must fall before an auto hit, in tenths of a block. 1.5 is the least for a smash. Type a number for more
setting.autoMace.prefer.help: Which mace to use. Auto: whichever does more damage through the target's armour. Or Density or Breach first
setting.autoMace.autoAttack.help: Hits as soon as your crosshair is on a target in reach. Smashes while falling, or stun slams a raised shield
setting.autoMace.hitTiming.help: Smart: waits for a bigger smash. First chance: hits at once. Last chance: hits at the last moment. None: last moment, any charge
setting.autoMace.minCharge.help: How charged your item must be for an early auto hit. Above 90% it crits for 1.5x damage. Last chance hits don't wait
setting.autoMace.aim.help: Aims at the closest target while you fall. Regular: on your screen. Silent: only for the server, your view stays
setting.autoMace.smoothness.help: How gradually the aim turns. 0 is instant. Too slow and you may fall past the target
setting.autoMace.aimRange.help: How far a target can be when the fall starts
setting.autoMace.stunSlam.help: On a shield facing you: an axe hit disables it, then the vanta. Auto: whenever the target blocks. Bind: the key arms it for 3 seconds
setting.autoMace.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your old slot after the hit
setting.autoMace.waitHurt.help: A target hit in the last half second takes less damage. Auto hits wait for that to end, unless it's the last chance
setting.autoMace.aimPart.help: Where to aim. Body: upper chest. Head: the head. Nearest: the closest point of the hitbox, which gets in reach first
setting.autoMace.axeDelay.help: Stun slam: ticks the axe is held before its hit, random in this range. It is picked that early before the target comes in reach, so the slam still lands in the air. 0 picks and hits in the same tick
setting.autoMace.stunDelay.help: Stun slam: ticks between the axe hit and the mace slam, random in this range. 1 is the fastest possible
setting.autoMace.maceDelay.help: Stun slam: ticks between switching to the mace and the slam, random in this range (never before the axe hit). 0 switches in the slam tick
setting.autoMace.hitAim.help: Legit: smoothly pulls your view onto the target. Silent: your view stays, only the hit is aimed. Off: hits where your crosshair is
setting.autoMace.aimSpeed.help: How fast Legit hit aim pulls your view onto the target
setting.autoMace.aimFov.help: Hit aim only turns to targets within this angle of where you look. 360: any direction, even behind you
setting.autoMace.drainKey.help: Shield drain: while this key is on, falling onto a shield clicks it with the mace several times a tick instead of the stun slam. Click, then press a key; Esc unbinds
setting.autoMace.drainBind.help: Hold: drains while the key is held. Toggle: a press turns draining on or off
setting.autoMace.drainClicks.help: Left clicks per tick while draining, like a fast autoclicker. Each is a normal swing and hit
setting.autoMace.drainFrom.help: Only drains once you've fallen at least this far. Below it the stun slam is used as normal, even with the key on
module.breachSwap.description: Adds the mace's Breach to your weapon hits
setting.breachSwap.minArmor.help: Only targets wearing at least this much armour, since Breach only cuts armour
setting.breachSwap.chance.help: How many of your hits get the swap
setting.breachSwap.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your weapon after the hit
module.spearReach.description: Hits with your spear from the longest reach allowed
setting.spearReach.onHold.help: Only while you hold the attack button
setting.spearReach.delay.help: Ticks to wait after the spear is charged before jabbing, like a reaction
module.spearLunge.description: Lunges forward with your spear on one key
setting.spearLunge.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your old slot after the jab
module.pearlGrapple.description: Pearls you next to a target to smash them
setting.pearlGrapple.range.help: How far a target can be
setting.pearlGrapple.fov.help: How far from your aim a target can be. The one nearest your crosshair is picked
setting.pearlGrapple.airOnly.help: Only targets in the air, like one launched for a smash
setting.pearlGrapple.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your old slot after the throw
module.autoMine.description: Mines the block you are looking at
setting.autoMine.inGuis.help: Keeps mining while a screen is open, like your inventory, chat or a chest
module.villageTrading.description: Repeats a villager trade as many times as it can
module.autoTotem.description: Puts a new totem in your off hand when one pops
setting.autoTotem.mode.help: Auto: opens your inventory and swaps after the delays. Legit: the same, after a human reaction. Hover: only swaps with your cursor on a totem
setting.autoTotem.openInventory.help: Hover: opens your inventory for you when a totem pops
setting.autoTotem.keep.help: Refills your off hand any time it is empty, not just after a pop. An off hand holding something else is left alone
setting.autoTotem.refill.help: Also puts a spare totem in the chosen hotbar slot, if that slot is empty (it never moves your items)
setting.autoTotem.reaction.help: Legit: how long to wait after a pop before opening the inventory
setting.autoTotem.clickDelay.help: Wait before each swap. Clicks also wait until you stand still, with no sprinting, sneaking or walking
setting.autoTotem.closeDelay.help: Wait before the inventory closes. Only if the module opened it
module.pearlCatch.description: Throws a pearl, then catches it with a wind charge
setting.pearlCatch.delay.help: Ticks from the pearl to the wind charge. Short delays catch almost every time. Long ones catch higher but miss more
setting.pearlCatch.launch.help: Only throws if the wind charge will also launch you. Waits up to 3 seconds for the pearl to come down
setting.pearlCatch.alwaysThrow.help: Throws the wind charge even when the math says it will miss. May still catch on laggy or modded servers
setting.pearlCatch.debug.help: Tells you in chat why a wind charge wasn't thrown. Only you see it
setting.pearlCatch.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your old slot after each throw
setting.frost_blink.mode.help: Default: holds once, then turns off after the set ticks. Pulse: lets go and holds again every that many ticks until turned off
setting.frost_blink.ticks.help: The longest one hold lasts. 20 ticks is 1 second. 16 leaves some room for lag spikes, 20 very little
setting.frost_blink.release-on-attack.he: Hitting something lets go of what is held first, so the hit lands at once from where you are
setting.frost_blink.ghost.help: Shows your hitbox where the server still thinks you are
setting.frost_blink.trail.help: Draws the path you moved since the server last saw you
setting.frost_blink.color.help: Colour of the ghost and the trail
setting.pearlCatch.aim.help: Silent: only the server sees you turn. Legit: your view turns smoothly to the catch
module.hitbox.description: Shows hitboxes in your own colour
setting.hitbox.expand.help: Makes the box bigger on every side, in hundredths of a block
setting.hitbox.self.help: Also your own hitbox in third person
setting.aimAssist.when.help: Always, only while you are in the air, or only while falling for a mace slam
setting.aimAssist.bones.help: Multipoint: the spot on the hitbox nearest your crosshair, a bit in from the edge. Or pick fixed body parts
setting.pearlCatch.lockMouse.help: Legit: your mouse can't move the view while it aims the catch
setting.pearlCatch.turnBack.help: Legit: turns your view back after the throw. Moving your mouse stops it. Off: your view stays where it aimed
setting.aimAssist.range.help: How far a target can be. While falling, it counts from where you'll be next, so fast falls aim in time
setting.aimAssist.speed.help: How fast your aim gets onto the target. 50% takes about 1/5 s, 100% is almost instant, more is faster still
setting.pearlCatch.legitSpeed.help: How fast your view turns to the catch and back. It speeds up as the throw gets close, so it's never late
setting.aimAssist.stayOnHitbox.help: While your crosshair is on the target, your mouse can't move it off. You can still slide along the hitbox
setting.autoMace.reaction.help: Randomness: ticks to wait once your crosshair is on a target, picked for each target. 0-0: at once
setting.spearReach.edge.help: Randomness: how far inside max reach the target must be to jab, new each jab. 0-0: right at the edge
setting.spearLunge.chainDelay.help: Randomness: extra ticks before each chained lunge while you hold the key
setting.pearlGrapple.reaction.help: Randomness: ticks after the key press before the throw, new each press
setting.pearlCatch.legitJitter.help: Randomness: how much the turn speed changes. Slower turns may miss more catches
setting.pearlCatch.legitNoise.help: Randomness: how far the turn slowly wanders off the aim. More can miss more catches
setting.pearlCatch.returnOffset.help: Randomness: the turn back ends up to this far from where you were looking, a new spot each time
setting.shieldBreaker.facing.help: Only shields facing you. Hits from behind land anyway
setting.shieldBreaker.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your item after the axe hit, random in this range
setting.shieldBreaker.chance.help: Randomness: how often it swaps when you hit a raised shield
module.autoDrain.description: Clears lava or water you are standing in
setting.autoDrain.area.help: In you: only liquid at your feet or head. Around you: also liquid within the radius, like lava next to you
setting.autoDrain.methods.help: Tried in this order: an empty bucket, a solid block from the list, or a cobweb if something is in the way
setting.autoDrain.blocks.help: Full solid blocks it may place into a liquid source, if nothing is in the way
setting.autoDrain.rotation.help: Silent: only the server sees you turn, smoothly. Legit: your view turns
setting.autoDrain.speed.help: How fast it turns to the liquid. Over 100% is faster still
setting.autoDrain.reaction.help: Randomness: ticks before it acts on a new source, new each time
setting.autoDrain.useDelay.help: Ticks between two right clicks. Holding right click normally repeats every 4
setting.autoDrain.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks before switching back to your old slot after the click
setting.autoDrain.skipFireRes.help: Leaves lava alone while you have Fire Resistance
setting.autoDrain.skipLakes.help: Ignores big pools of 8 or more blocks, like lakes or the sea. Only drains what is poured on you
setting.hitbox.colorMode.help: Custom: your colour. Team: their team colour, or yours if none. Health: green to red as they lose health
setting.hitbox.throughWalls.help: Off: only blocks in front of it hide it, never the entity itself or other entities
setting.spearLunge.chain.help: Holding the key lunges again whenever it can. Off: one lunge per press
setting.autoMace.spearReach.help: On every slam fall it holds a spear while falling, finds the target as far as the spear reaches, then swaps to the mace (or the stun slam's axe) for the hit, so it lands sooner
setting.autoMace.spearUse.help: Every slam: reaches with the spear on every fall, so the hit lands sooner but from a shorter fall (about half the damage). Stun slams only: the spear reaches only for a stun slam on a raised shield, keeping full smash damage
setting.hideInList.help: Hides it from the on-screen module list while it is on
setting.hideNotifications.help: No notification when it is turned on or off
module.noSneakBob.description: Stops the camera dipping when you crouch
setting.noSneakBob.mode.help: Instant: your view drops to sneak height at once, like 1.8. Keep height: sneaking doesn't move your view, unless under a low ceiling
setting.spearLunge.jump.help: On the ground, jumps just before the lunge so it carries much farther. The lunge comes a moment later
setting.spearLunge.buffer.help: Ticks a key press is saved if it can't jab yet. After that it's dropped, so it never lunges late
setting.spearLunge.pick.help: Same tick: swaps and jabs at once, for vanilla. Spear first: jabs once the spear is charged, for Paper. Auto: Spear first on Paper
module.smashGuard.description: Raises your shield when someone tries to smash you
setting.smashGuard.reach.help: How close a falling player must get to hit you. Normal reach is 3 blocks
setting.smashGuard.margin.help: Ticks early to raise the shield. Your ping is already counted
setting.smashGuard.face.help: If the faller is behind you, or you aim at a door, chest or animal, turns to the faller without moving your view
setting.smashGuard.hotbar.help: If there's no shield in your off hand, uses one from your hotbar
setting.smashGuard.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks after lowering the shield before switching back to your old slot
setting.smashGuard.whileSmashing.help: Also while you are falling to smash. A raised shield stops your own hit
setting.smashGuard.maceOnly.help: Only against fallers holding a vanta. Off: anyone falling far enough to smash
module.windClutch.description: Uses a wind charge to stop fall damage
setting.windClutch.minDamage.help: Only for landings that would deal at least this much damage, after armour and effects
setting.windClutch.notOntoTarget.help: Not when you'd land on someone you can smash. The smash stops your fall anyway
setting.windClutch.swapBack.help: Wait in ticks after the throw before switching back to your old slot
module.windChargeAura.description: Punches wind charges away before they hit you
setting.windChargeAura.aim.help: Silent: only the server sees you turn. Legit: your view turns smoothly onto the charge, faster the closer it is
setting.windChargeAura.window.help: Only charges that will hit you within this many ticks. A charge flies 1.5 blocks a tick
setting.windChargeAura.range.help: How far the charge's box may be to punch it. Vanilla reaches about 4 blocks: a charge is easier to hit than a player. It still has to be under your crosshair
setting.windChargeAura.onlyOthers.help: Leaves your own wind charges alone
setting.aimAssist.itemFilter.help: Off: aims with any item. Whitelist: only with the chosen items. Blacklist: never with the chosen items
setting.aimAssist.items.help: Items for the filter: the ones it aims with in Whitelist, or never aims with in Blacklist
module.freecam.description: Flies the camera around while you stay still
setting.freecam.speed.help: How fast the camera flies forwards, backwards and sideways
setting.freecam.verticalSpeed.help: How fast Jump and Sneak move the camera up and down
setting.freecam.sprintMultiplier.help: Holding sprint multiplies both speeds by this
setting.freecam.scrollSpeed.help: The mouse wheel changes the camera speed instead of the hotbar. Resets to Speed next time
setting.freecam.smooth.help: The camera speeds up and slows down gently instead of starting and stopping at once
setting.freecam.acceleration.help: How quickly the camera reaches full speed or stops. Lower glides longer
setting.freecam.noclip.help: The camera flies through blocks. Off: blocks stop it. Your player never moves
setting.freecam.interact.help: What your clicks hit. Camera: what the camera looks at, if your player can reach it. Player: what your player faces. Off: nothing
setting.freecam.control.help: What your keys and mouse move. Camera: the camera, while your player stands still. Player: your player, the view stays put
setting.freecam.keepSneaking.help: If you were sneaking when Freecam started, your player keeps sneaking so it can't walk off edges
setting.freecam.disableOnDamage.help: Turns Freecam off the moment your player takes damage
setting.freecam.showBody.help: Shows your player where it stands, so the camera can see you
setting.freecam.hideHand.help: Hides your hand and held item while the camera is away
setting.freecam.customFov.help: Gives the camera its own field of view instead of your game's
setting.freecam.follow.help: The camera moves with your player when it gets pushed, falls or teleports
setting.freecam.keepPosition.help: The camera starts where you left it last time, in the same world. Off: it starts at your player
setting.freecam.renderAroundCamera.help: Draws the world around the camera, like spectator mode, but only chunks near your player exist. Off: draws around your player
setting.freecam.returnMode.help: When Freecam turns off. Instant: jumps back at once. Smooth: the camera flies back
setting.freecam.returnTime.help: How long the smooth flight back takes
module.frost_elymacebot.description: Flies an elytra with rockets, swaps to a chestplate in the air and smashes your opponent with a mace, pass after pass (beta)
module.frost_wtap.description: Resets your sprint after each hit for more knockback
module.armorHud.description: Shows your armor and how worn it is
module.crosshair.description: A cleaner crosshair with hit markers
module.dynamicIsland.description: A small pill at the top that shows the time
module.frost_interface.description: Client colour, toggle sounds and small overlays
module.frost_keystrokes.description: Shows your key presses, clicks and CPS
module.frost_notifications.description: Shows a popup when a module turns on or off
module.potionHud.description: Shows your effects and the time left
module.rearview.description: A small mirror that shows what is behind you
module.sessionInfo.description: Shows play time, kills, FPS and ping
module.targetHud.description: Shows the health of who you are fighting
module.frost_opwindcharges.description: Saves up wind charge pushes for one big launch
module.frost_antibot.description: Stops combat modules from targeting fake players
module.frost_clientspoofer.description: Shows servers a different client name
module.frost_nickhider.description: Hides your name on your screen
module.frost_jumpreset.description: Jumps when you are hit to take less knockback
module.frost_antifireball.description: Hits fireballs away before they reach you
module.frost_autoclicker.description: Clicks for you while you hold the mouse
module.frost_autotool.description: Picks the best tool for the block you mine
module.frost_clutch.description: Places a block under you when you fall
module.frost_eagle.description: Sneaks at the edge of blocks while you bridge
module.frost_hitflick.description: Turns your hits to knock players where you want
module.frost_hitselect.description: Only lets through the hits that are worth it
module.frost_ladderclutch.description: Places a ladder to stop a fall
module.frost_scaffold.description: Places blocks under you as you walk
module.frost_ambience.description: Changes the time and weather you see
module.bedEsp.description: Shows beds and what is guarding them
module.frost_blockoverlay.description: Highlights the block you are looking at
module.frost_freelook.description: Look around without turning your player
module.instantReplay.description: Saves the last few moments as a clip
module.lootBeams.description: Light beams on dropped items by rarity
module.menuTheme.description: Gives Minecraft's menus the client's style
module.frost_perspective.description: Hold a key to see yourself from behind
module.storageEsp.description: Shows chests and shulkers through walls
module.trajectories.description: Shows where your shots and projectiles in flight land
module.waterEsp.description: Shows players and items through walls as water
setting.esp.colorBy.help: Single: one color. Team: their team color. Health: green to red. Distance: near to far color. Type: players, hostile, passive and items
setting.esp.highlightFriends.help: Friends always show in their own color
setting.esp.hurtFlash.help: A target flashes white for a moment when it takes damage
setting.esp.distanceFade.help: Far targets fade out so close ones stand out
setting.blockEsp.blocks.help: The blocks to show. Click to pick any block
setting.blockEsp.coloring.help: Block: each block in its own color (ores in their gem's). Custom: your color
setting.blockEsp.shape.help: Full block: a whole cube. Exact shape: the block's real size, like a slab or a chest
setting.blockEsp.merge.help: Blocks touching each other show as one shape
setting.blockEsp.exposedOnly.help: Only blocks with a side open to the air
setting.blockEsp.pulse.help: The boxes gently glow brighter and dimmer
setting.blockEsp.limit.help: The most blocks drawn at once, nearest first
setting.dynamicIsland.battery.help: Shows your laptop's battery charge next to the time. Hidden on computers without a battery
setting.dynamicIsland.batteryPercent.hel: The charge as a number next to the battery icon
module.killEffects.description: Plays a short effect when you get a kill
setting.killEffects.mode.help: Soul: a soul rises and fades. Lightning: a bolt strikes. Mark: an X over where it fell. Shockwave: a ring spreads over the ground
setting.killEffects.mobs.help: Also play it when you kill a mob, not only a player
setting.tracers.curve.help: How much the lines bend. 0 makes them straight
setting.tracers.arrows.help: Arrows for players off screen, at the screen edge or round the crosshair. Off draws lines to the edge instead
setting.nametags.accents.help: Friends' names in the client accent, team members' names in their team color
setting.storageEsp.labels.help: A square label over each container: what it is, how far, and how many stacks it holds if you opened it
setting.hitbox.style.help: Lines: plain edges. Glow: a faint, wider line around them
setting.crosshair.preset.help: Cross: arms and a dot. Dot: one dot. Circle: a ring. Valorant: sharp pixel arms with faint outer arms
setting.crosshair.reachRing.help: A faint ring when what you aim at is close enough to hit
setting.worldModifier.customTime.help: Off: each theme at its own time of day. On: every theme at the time you set
setting.worldModifier.time.help: The time of day: the sun or moon moves and the light changes with it
setting.frost_blockoverlay.glow.help: A soft glow around the lines
setting.frost_blockoverlay.animate.help: The highlight slides to the next block and fades in and out
setting.frost_blockoverlay.showId.help: Also shows the block's id in the info label
setting.frost_blockoverlay.info.help: A square label under the crosshair with the block's name and how long it takes to break with what you hold
setting.worldModifier.artStyle.help: Gives the whole picture the theme's own look, not only the sky
setting.worldModifier.styleStrength.help: How strong the theme's look is. At 0% the picture is untouched
setting.esp.healthColor.help: Stepped: green, yellow, orange or red by quarters of health. Smooth: blends between them
setting.esp.healthText.help: Writes the health next to the bar
setting.esp.show.help: Box: the lines. Fill: a light tint inside. Outline: a thin black edge on the lines. Health: a health bar. Glow: a faint light around the box
setting.hitbox.lineWeight.help: How thick the lines are, in screen pixels
setting.hitbox.outline.help: A thin black edge on both sides of the lines, so they show on any background
setting.tracers.color.help: The line color. With Team coloring, for players without a team
setting.tracers.coloring.help: Single: your color. Team: their team color. Distance: red up close, yellow at mid range, your color further out
setting.tracers.lineWeight.help: How thick the lines are, in screen pixels
setting.tracers.outline.help: A thin black edge around the lines and arrows, so they show on a bright sky
setting.trajectories.style.help: Line: one clean line. Dots: small squares along the path. None: no path lines at all, just the landing mark and tags
setting.trajectories.lineWeight.help: How thick the line is, in screen pixels
setting.trajectories.outline.help: A thin black edge around the line and the landing mark
setting.trajectories.color.help: The color of the path and the landing mark
setting.trajectories.label: Label
setting.trajectories.label.help: The flight time under the landing point. Shadow: text with a shadow. Box: on a dark box. Off: no label
setting.trajectories.inFlight.help: Also shows pearls, wind charges, arrows, tridents, potions and snowballs already flying: their path, where they land, and a tag there with what it is and the time left. Blue: yours. Red: someone else's
setting.nametags.background.help: Box: a square dark box behind the tag. Shadow: no box, the text has a drop shadow. None: no box, the text has a thin black outline
setting.nametags.ping.help: The player's ping from the tab list, when the server sends it
setting.nametags.durability.help: How worn each item is: a thin bar under it, or the percent left
setting.bedEsp.show.help: Outline: the bed. Tag: team and distance. Defense: full layers and what covers it. Gaps: open sides, in red
setting.bedEsp.coloring.help: Team: each bed in its team's color. Custom: every bed in your color
setting.bedEsp.color.help: The color of every bed when Coloring is Custom
setting.bedEsp.lineWeight.help: How thick the outline is, in screen pixels
setting.bedEsp.lineOutline.help: A thin black line on both sides of the outline, so it shows on any background
setting.bedEsp.fill.help: How strongly the sides you can see are tinted. 0 for none
setting.bedEsp.background.help: Box: a square dark box behind the tag. Shadow: no box, the text has a drop shadow. None: no box, the text has a thin black outline
setting.storageEsp.coloring.help: By type: chests amber, trapped chests red, ender chests violet, shulkers their dye, barrels brown. Custom: all in your color
setting.storageEsp.color.help: The color of every container when Coloring is Custom
setting.storageEsp.lineWeight.help: How thick the outline is, in screen pixels
setting.storageEsp.lineOutline.help: A thin black line on both sides of the outline, so it shows on any background
setting.storageEsp.fill.help: How strongly the sides you can see are tinted. 0 for none
setting.storageEsp.background.help: Box: a square dark box behind the label. Shadow: no box, the text has a drop shadow. None: no box, the text has a thin black outline
setting.blockEsp.show.help: Fill: a faint tint on the sides you can see. Outline: a line round each shape. Tracers: thin lines from the crosshair
setting.blockEsp.lineWeight.help: How thick the outlines and tracers are, in screen pixels
setting.blockEsp.lineOutline.help: A thin black line on both sides of each outline, so it shows on any background
setting.blockEsp.distanceFade.help: Far blocks are drawn fainter, so near ones stand out
setting.waterEsp.teamColor.help: Players in their team's color in Bedwars, Skywars and similar; everyone else in your color
setting.waterEsp.color.help: The water's color for everything without a team color
setting.waterEsp.lineWeight.help: How thick the rim round each body is, in screen pixels
setting.waterEsp.light.help: Light rippling through the water. Off keeps the water still and flat
setting.lootBeams.beams.help: Rare+: only rare, epic and enchanted items. All: every item. None: no beams
setting.lootBeams.lineWeight.help: How thick the beams are, in screen pixels
setting.lootBeams.tags.help: A small label with the item's name in its rarity color and the count
setting.lootBeams.background.help: Box: a square dark box behind the tag. Shadow: no box, the text has a drop shadow. None: no box, the text has a thin black outline
setting.frost_blockoverlay.mode.help: Outline: a line round the block. Fill: a faint flat tint. Box: both
setting.frost_blockoverlay.thickness.hel: How thick the outline is, in screen pixels
setting.frost_blockoverlay.lineOutline.h: A thin black line on both sides of the outline, so it shows on any block
setting.shape.help: Rounded: round corners. Squared: sharp square corners everywhere, on the card and on everything in it. Cut: corners cut off at 45 degrees
setting.corners.help: How big the corners are (100% as designed)
setting.background.help: Theme: the theme's card, lit from above. Flat: the theme's color, one flat tone. Custom: your color. Gradient: two of your colors, left to right
setting.backgroundOpacity.help: 0%: no background, only what is on it
setting.border.help: Hairline: the theme's thin rim. None: no edge. Solid: a line in your color. Accent: a line in the accent
setting.shadow.help: Soft: two soft shadows under it. Hard: a crisp offset shadow. Glow: a soft light in the accent. None: flat
setting.accentBar.help: A short bar in the accent along one edge of each card
setting.accent.help: Theme: the client's accent. Custom: a color of its own
setting.textTone.help: Theme: the theme's HUD text color. Custom: a color of its own
setting.animations.help: Off: changes show at once, nothing slides, springs or fades in
setting.frost_notifications.Shape.help: Rounded: round corners. Squared: sharp square corners everywhere, on the card and on everything in it. Cut: corners cut off at 45 degrees
setting.frost_notifications.Background.h: Theme: the theme's card, lit from above. Flat: the theme's color, one flat tone. Custom: your color. Gradient: two of your colors, left to right
setting.frost_notifications.Border.help: Hairline: the theme's thin rim. None: no edge. Solid: a line in your color. Accent: a line in the accent
setting.frost_notifications.Shadow-Style: Soft: two soft shadows under it. Hard: a crisp offset shadow. Glow: a soft light in the accent. None: flat
setting.frost_notifications.Accent-Bar.h: A short bar in the accent along one edge of each card
setting.frost_notifications.Animations.h: Off: changes show at once, nothing slides, springs or fades in
setting.frost_keystrokes.Shape.help: Rounded: round corners. Squared: sharp square corners everywhere, on the card and on everything in it. Cut: corners cut off at 45 degrees
setting.frost_keystrokes.Background.help: Theme: the theme's card, lit from above. Flat: the theme's color, one flat tone. Custom: your color. Gradient: two of your colors, left to right
setting.frost_keystrokes.Border.help: Hairline: the theme's thin rim. None: no edge. Solid: a line in your color. Accent: a line in the accent
setting.frost_keystrokes.Shadow-Style.he: Soft: two soft shadows under it. Hard: a crisp offset shadow. Glow: a soft light in the accent. None: flat
setting.frost_keystrokes.Accent-Bar.help: A short bar in the accent along one edge of each card
setting.frost_keystrokes.Animations.help: Off: changes show at once, nothing slides, springs or fades in
setting.esp.lineWidth.help: How thick the box lines are, in screen pixels. The same at every distance
setting.esp.outlineWidth.help: How thick the outline around each target is, in screen pixels. The same at every distance
setting.esp.edgeWidth.help: How thick the black edge on each side of the box lines is, in screen pixels
setting.frost_swordbot.humanize.help: How human it plays. 0%: as sharp as it can. Higher: slower, varied reactions, distances and timings, crit jumps and jump resets now and then let go, and the aim of a hand on a mouse - movers followed a little late, big turns in two moves, the pitch left alone when near enough, a slight tremor and a whiff now and then. 100%: all of it, like a person
setting.frost_swordbot.aim-smoothness.he: How smooth the aim turns. Turns speed up and slow into the target; higher is slower and softer
setting.frost_elymacebot.target-range.he: How far away it looks for an opponent. On a public server it only ever fights the player you hit yourself
setting.frost_elymacebot.attack-altitude: How high above your opponent it climbs before a pass. Higher: longer falls and bigger smashes, but longer passes
The fall it wants before it swings. The smash adds 4 damage a block for the first 3 blocks, 2 for the next 5 and 1 after that (Density adds more). It never plans a fall that would kill you if the hit missed, unless a totem is in your off hand
setting.frost_elymacebot.rocket-usage.he: Economic: a rocket only when it climbs or runs out of speed. Aggressive: keeps a rocket burning, for faster passes
setting.frost_elymacebot.breach-swap.hel: On the hit, picks whichever mace hurts most this time (Breach into heavy armour on short falls, Density otherwise), in the same tick as the swing
setting.frost_elymacebot.axe-shield-brea: When the target holds a shield up towards you, the first hit is an axe to disable it and the mace follows
setting.frost_elymacebot.wind-charge-saf: If a fall would hurt (a missed pass, a knock off the elytra), throws a wind charge under you before you land
setting.frost_elymacebot.offhand-totem.h: Keeps a totem in your off hand and swaps the chestplate from the hotbar. Off: the chestplate rides in the off hand, so the swap is one right-click with the mace still held
setting.frost_elymacebot.dodge.help: Turns away from arrows and tridents flying at you while it climbs or cruises
setting.frost_elymacebot.eat.help: Eats when hungry (a golden apple when hurt), while far from the fight
How smooth the view turns. Higher is slower and softer
setting.frost_elymacebot.humanize.help: How human the view moves: slight noise, a hand that lags on big turns and a tremor. Strikes stay sharp
setting.frost_elymacebot.chat-messages.h: Tells you in chat what is missing from your kit and who it fights
setting.frost_elymacebot.fight-log.help: Writes every fight tick by tick, with each pass summed up, to frost-fights in your game folder
module.namePlate.description: Shows your name plate in game too - drag it in the click GUI to move it
module.esp2d.description: Shows players and mobs through walls
setting.esp2d.colorBy.help: Single: one color. Team: their team color. Health: green to red. Distance: near to far color. Type: players, hostile, passive and items
setting.esp2d.highlightFriends.help: Friends always show in their own color
setting.esp2d.hurtFlash.help: A target flashes white for a moment when it takes damage
setting.esp2d.distanceFade.help: Far targets fade out so close ones stand out
setting.esp2d.lineWidth.help: How thick the box lines are, in screen pixels. The same at every distance
setting.esp2d.outlineWidth.help: How thick the outline around each target is, in screen pixels. The same at every distance
setting.esp2d.show.help: Box: the lines. Fill: a light tint inside. Outline: a thin black edge on the lines. Health: a health bar. Glow: a faint light around the box
setting.esp2d.edgeWidth.help: How thick the black edge on each side of the box lines is, in screen pixels
setting.esp2d.healthColor.help: Stepped: green, yellow, orange or red by quarters of health. Smooth: blends between them
setting.esp2d.healthText.help: Writes the health next to the bar
module.noJumpDelay.description: Shorter wait between jumps while holding jump
module.freeLook.description: Hold to turn the camera around you without turning your player
module.perspective.description: Hold to see yourself from behind or in front
module.fastPlace.description: Places blocks with a shorter delay between right clicks
module.clientSpoofer.description: Tells the server another client brand
module.keystrokes.description: WASD, mouse buttons with CPS and space bar
